findings.title: Health endpoint no longer timed out in bounded probe
findings.recommendation: Attribute remaining latency using existing internal phase telemetry and proxy timing before optimization.

findings.title: High process CPU and elevated RSS remain
findings.evidence: CPU average 83.4%, p95 107.2%; RSS 1089-1217 MiB; cgroup peak 1361.8 MiB
findings.recommendation: Repeat after stable uptime and use bounded heap/event-loop/GC telemetry in a controlled window.

findings.title: Rollback rate remains material
findings.evidence: 4489 rollback delta; 299.0/min; rollback ratio 27.55% of commit+rollback counters
findings.recommendation: Use approved statement/lane attribution; do not infer failed business operations from the aggregate counter.

findings.title: Dead tuples remain material in high-write tables
findings.recommendation: Review DBA-owned autovacuum activity and thresholds without changing them in this audit.

findings.title: Public diagnostics redact required runtime/SSE counters
findings.evidence: heap, event-loop, GC, active clients, V1/V2 split, fan-out and coalescing unavailable
findings.recommendation: Expose bounded sanitized diagnostics through authenticated internal system status.

specificQuestions.sseSerialization: Not attributable from public metrics; single-client payload is descriptive only.
specificQuestions.flightUpdates: Update rates are measured, but necessity is not proven without statement/lane attribution.
specificQuestions.diagnosticOverhead: No indication from this audit; runtime observation was not enabled publicly.
specificQuestions.nextOptimizationCandidate: Health phase/proxy latency attribution first; then SSE serialization and persistence lanes under controlled profile.
